The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim" is an epic open-world role-playing game set in the fantasy world of Tamriel. The plot revolves around the return of dragons, ancient creatures thought to be extinct. [Scene: On a cool, windy morning, the camera reveals the scenery through the eyes of the protagonist as he slowly regains consciousness.]

Rarock: "Hey, you. You're finally awake. You were trying to cross the border, right? Walked right into that Imperial ambush, same as us, and that thief over there."

[The camera cuts to fellow prisoners. We can see Rarock, Ulfric Stormcloak, and an anxious-looking thief.]

Thief (Lokir): "Damn you, Stormcloaks. Skyrim was fine until you came along. Empire was nice and lazy. If they hadn't been looking for you, I could've stolen that horse and been halfway to Hammerfell. You there. You and me, we shouldn't be here. It's these Stormcloaks the Empire wants."

Rarock: “We’re all brothers and sisters in binds now, thief.”

[As the sound recedes, the camera turns to reveal the cold northern landscape. And soon, the camera focuses on the main character again.]

Driver: "Watch your tongue! You're speaking to Ulfric Stormcloak, the true High King."

Lokir: "Ulfric? The Jarl of Windhelm? You're the leader of the rebellion. But if they've captured you... Oh gods, where are they taking us?"

Larok: "I don't know where we're going, but Sovngarde awaits."

Lokir: "No, this can't be happening. This isn't happening."

[The guard approaches and turns his attention to each prisoner in turn.]

Guard: “Hey, what village are you from, horse thief?”

Lokir: “Why do you care?”

Jailer: "A Nord's last thoughts should be of home."

Rokir: "Rorikstead. I'm... I'm from Rorikstead."

[Now, the guard looks at the player character. This moment is an important turning point as the player moves into the process of creating his or her character.]

Guard: “And you? Who are you?”
